_comment: Art prompts for No. 21, written 2026-11-02. Generated in ChatGPT Image (the latest image model) by computer control of the ChatGPT desktop app, or at chatgpt.com in the built-in browser pane when the app grant is refused in a scheduled run, then optimized to public/assets/spots/no21_<file> at 900 px, JPEG q84. Each prompt is one subject, close in, in action, a likeable face where there is one (sokno-ear-art skill; Andy 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-19). The people differ in hair, view and hand action so the week does not read as one picture repeated. Prefix in ChatGPT: 'Generate an image, 1:1 aspect ratio.' (3:2 for the feature) and append the palette hex codes ink #171512, cream #F3E8D2, teal #7FAEA3, rust #A94A34.
suffix: Predominantly black ink linework with stipple dots and cross-hatch shading, slight engraving texture, warm cream paper background, restrained accents in muted teal and rust red. Charming and specific, not generic. Hand-drawn local newspaper engraving, not a photograph, not flat vector. No text or letters anywhere.

ambc-fall-fest.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a mountain biker in mid-air throwing a sideways whip off a dirt jump, seen from slightly below and in front so the bike is tilted nearly flat and the rider's grinning face under a full-face helmet is turned toward us, cropped so rider and bike fill the frame edge to edge. Knobby tires, dust flying off the rear wheel, a rust-red jersey, one knee tucked, both hands locked on the bars. No crowd, no trees, no horizon, no background scenery.

latin-knox-printshop.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a laughing young woman DJ with dark curly hair pulled up, seen from the front across her mixer, one hand on a fader and the other hand raised high with a finger pointed up, cropped from the waist up with the mixer's knobs large in the foreground. Big hoop earrings, a teal top, headphones around her neck, eyes on the dance floor. No room, no crowd, no background scenery.

808-college-night.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a young man with shaggy blond hair singing into a microphone on a stand while playing a Telecaster-style electric guitar, cropped from the chest up and seen from his right side as he leans into the mic. Mouth open mid-note, eyes nearly shut, a band tee, a guitar strap over the shoulder, the headstock crossing the lower corner. No stage, no crowd, no background scenery.

sokno-sourdough-first-friday.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a smiling woman with gray-streaked hair in a bun pouring a dark chocolate tonic from a small glass bottle into a tiny sample cup held by another person's hand, cropped from her shoulders up with the pour and the cup large in the center of the frame. A thin stream of liquid mid-pour, an apron strap, a broken square of chocolate on the counter beside the cup. No shop, no background scenery.

cut-corners-fbn.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a dancer with a shaved head and a wide-open laughing mouth, arms thrown up and crossed above the head, caught mid-bounce with sweat flying, cropped from the ribs up and seen straight on. A mesh tank top, a chain necklace swinging, a rust-red light catching one cheek. No club, no crowd, no background scenery.

bow-wow-bingo-printshop.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: an old gray-muzzled beagle with its chin resting on a bingo card on a picnic table, looking up at us with big hopeful eyes, while a human hand with a bingo dauber marks a square beside its nose, cropped close so the dog's head and the card fill the frame. A few dabbed squares already on the card, a sweet floppy ear, a beer glass's base at the edge. No patio, no crowd, no background scenery.

uptop-karaoke-kerns.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a man with a thick dark beard and a backwards cap belting into a handheld wireless microphone with both hands wrapped around it, eyes squeezed shut and head tilted back, cropped from the chest up and seen from a three-quarter angle. A flannel shirt, a string of patio bulbs blurred behind his head, a drink glass raised by a friend's hand at the edge of the frame. No rooftop view, no crowd, no background scenery.

all-play-live-kerns.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a girl of about eight with two braids and a gap-toothed grin slamming both hands down on a big round game-show buzzer, her father's hand landing on it a moment too late beside hers, cropped from her shoulders up with the buzzer large in the foreground. Her eyes wide with glee, a striped shirt, the buzzer's dome catching light. No lawn, no stage, no background scenery.

goat-yoga-kerns.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a small black-and-white goat with a tiny bow tie standing squarely on the back of a woman in tabletop pose on a yoga mat, the woman turning her head toward us with a delighted laugh, cropped close so the goat and her upper body fill the frame. Short red hair, a teal long-sleeve top and full-length leggings, the goat's little hooves planted on her shoulder blades, its ears perked. No lawn, no crowd, no background scenery.

moss-meander.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a smiling older man with a white beard and a knit cap crouched close to a mossy boulder, holding a small jeweler's hand lens up to his eye with one hand and touching a tuft of moss with the other, cropped from the chest up so his face, the lens and the moss fill the frame. Tiny moss stalks standing up under the lens, a rust-red scarf, a kind squint. No forest, no trail, no background scenery.

wilderness-basics.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: two hands striking a ferro rod with a knife spine so a shower of sparks falls onto a nest of dry tinder, the first small flame just catching, with a young woman's focused face with a dark ponytail leaning in above her hands, cropped close so the hands, the sparks and the tinder fill the lower two thirds of the frame. Curls of bark shavings, the sparks drawn as bright streaks, a wool sleeve. No campsite, no woods, no background scenery.

bird-banding.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a tiny songbird, a yellow-rumped warbler, held gently in the bander's grip between two fingers with its head poking out, while a second pair of fingers closes a tiny numbered aluminum band around its leg with small pliers, extreme close-up so the bird and the hands fill the frame. A bright alert eye, feather detail, a gloveless careful hand, a teal accent on the bird's crown. No station, no trees, no background scenery.

sound-bath-ijams.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a woman with long silver hair and closed eyes and a serene smile running a suede mallet around the rim of a large crystal singing bowl held in her other hand, cropped from the chest up and seen from the front with the bowl large in the lower frame. Fine ripple lines rising off the rim to show the sound, a loose linen top, rings on her fingers. No room, no mats, no background scenery.

specials-board.prompt: A vintage local-newspaper engraving: a tall orange cocktail in a highball glass with a wedge of orange on the rim, being set down on a bar by a bartender's hand, with a small orange-and-white checkered football resting on the bar beside it, extreme close-up so the glass and the football fill the frame. Condensation beads on the glass, ice, a black cocktail straw, the football's laces up. No bar room, no screens, no background scenery.
